_doc: Single source of truth for code coverage thresholds. See REPO-STANDARDS-SPEC [COVERAGE-THRESHOLDS-JSON]. NO GitHub repo variables. NO env vars. This file is read by the internal _coverage_check recipe inside make test. make test exits non-zero if measured < threshold. Thresholds ratchet UP only.
_conformance_gate_removed: The `conformance` block (threshold 100, max_false_positives 0) was DELETED 2026-08-08 at the user's direction. The floor over a corpus the code had been fitted to was the incentive that produced spelling-fitted predicates (CONFORMANCE-INTEGRITY-AUDIT §6.3), and the measurement itself cannot run since Basilisk's withdrawal from python/typing. Conformance remains a regression indicator only ([CHKARCH-CONFORMANCE]): never a gate, never a target, never published. Do not reintroduce a conformance threshold to this file.
